SELECT CAST(i.id AS CHAR) AS id,
       i.material_desc,
       COALESCE((
           SELECT JSON_ARRAYAGG(JSON_OBJECT(
                      'customer_id', CAST(b.customer_id AS CHAR),
                      'item_desc', b.item_desc))
           FROM item_l1gn7kim_sub b
           WHERE b.Item_id = i.id
             AND b.is_deleted = 0
       ), '[]') AS cust_item_bind_json
FROM JSON_TABLE(CONCAT('[', '{{node:code_node_CibItemIDs.data.itemIdCsv}}', ']'),
                '$[*]' COLUMNS (mid BIGINT PATH '$')) sel
JOIN item i
  ON i.id = sel.mid
 AND i.is_deleted = 0
